sources.title: ISO 14649-10:2004 — General process data
sources.readScope: Published Edition 2; abstract, process data, generic machining-feature catalogue and its exclusions
sources.supports: Feature vocabulary and workingsteps are distinct; 14649-10 requires technology-specific part
sources.limitations: Only catalog/abstract read; not full EXPRESS schema, not product conformance

sources.title: ISO 14649-11:2004 — Process data for milling
sources.readScope: Published Edition 2; abstract: milling/drilling, 2.5D and freeform scope and excluded items
sources.supports: Milling process representation uses -10 common definitions; does not itself define all manufacturing features
sources.limitations: Only catalog/abstract; not claiming all STEP-NC codes supported

sources.title: TopExp Class Reference, OCCT 8.0.1
sources.editionOrPublishedOn: 8.0.1 documentation; page release date not asserted
sources.supports: Face/edge adjacency and instance location must be explicit in topology evidence
sources.limitations: Index or map order not stable cross revision; OCCT 8.0.1 is not frozen product runtime

sources.title: BRepAdaptor_Surface Class Reference, OCCT 8.0.1
sources.editionOrPublishedOn: 8.0.1 documentation; page release date not asserted
sources.readScope: Face adaptor Restriction, local coordinate system, tolerance, geometric surface interface
sources.supports: Geometry type and domain can be extracted, but surface type is insufficient to infer machining intent
sources.limitations: Analytical recognition still needs material-side, closure and neighboring evidence

sources.title: BRepCheck_Analyzer Class Reference, OCCT 8.0.1
sources.editionOrPublishedOn: 8.0.1 documentation; page release date not asserted
sources.readScope: IsValid and exact-method description; invalid geometry diagnostics
sources.supports: Invalid or unchecked B-Rep must not be marked verified machining input
sources.limitations: Validation may use finite sample/optional exact algorithm; not generic machining solvability

sources.title: BRepTools_History Class Reference, OCCT 8.0.1
sources.editionOrPublishedOn: 8.0.1 documentation; page release date not asserted
sources.readScope: Generated/Modified/Removed, supported topology types and Merge() semantics
sources.supports: Topological lineage, when available, supports controlled rebind candidates
sources.limitations: Only history from operations that actually captured it; imported unrelated STEP revisions lack guaranteed lineage

sources.title: A Feature-Based Machining System Using STEP
sources.organizationOrAuthors: Frederick M. Proctor and Thomas Kramer / NIST
sources.readScope: NIST paper landing abstract / bibliographic metadata only
sources.supports: Feature-based manufacturing provides a semantic interface between design and machining planning
sources.limitations: Historical motivation, not endorsement of Procet algorithms or evidence of standard compliance

sources.title: BRepClass3d_SolidClassifier Class Reference, OCCT 8.0.1
sources.editionOrPublishedOn: 8.0.1 documentation; page release date not asserted
sources.supports: Point-in-solid classification can provide partial material-side evidence
sources.limitations: Near-boundary tolerance and complex shape ambiguity require conservative handling
